fieldNotes.site: Williamsburg A-B brewery (opened 1972) at 7801 Pocahontas Trail, adjacent to Busch Gardens. Large brewery building in a wooded campus setting; trailer drop yards and rail.
fieldNotes.truckGate: CONFIRMED. Street View showed a posted 'TRUCK ENTRANCE' sign at the dedicated truck entrance road; z19 satellite shows a multi-lane guarded truck-gate building with a canopy over the lanes and trucks queued at it. Clear controlled checkpoint.
fieldNotes.guardShack: CONFIRMED. The z19 satellite shows a distinct guardhouse/checkpoint structure straddling multiple truck lanes at the truck entrance - a classic multi-lane guarded gate. guardShack TRUE.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Paved truck staging area before the gate visible in z19 imagery; trucks can wait outside the checkpoint.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Trailer drop yards near the truck gate and along the SE side of the brewery; ~180 trailers visible, capacity ~280.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock banks with trailers backed in along the S/SE faces of the brewery building; estimated ~35 (band 25-50).
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail spurs run into the property on the SE side.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town wooded setting outside Williamsburg, surrounded by forest and the Busch Gardens campus - classified Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Multi-lane truck gate with wide apron leaves room for an express bypass.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Boxed operational footprint ~185 acres (excludes wooded buffer).

citations.claim: AB maintains a dedicated Williamsburg VA facility page; brewery at 7801 Pocahontas Trail opened 1972.

verification.rationale: Williamsburg brewery operating with a live AB facility page; not in the 2026 closure set, no negative signal found.
